headline: Brendan Sorsby to the NFL supplemental draft: What to know

headline: QB Brendan Sorsby plans to apply for NFL supplemental draft
description: Amid legal wrangling over his NCAA eligibility, Texas Tech transfer quarterback Brendan Sorsby plans to apply for the NFL's supplemental draft.

headline: What is the NFL supplemental draft?
description: Some years, the NFL also holds a supplemental draft, a mechanism that allows teams to bid draft picks on players who, for various reasons, did not enter the regular spring draft.
